description: Detailed composition effect by factor (Yun weights on 2016-19 coefficients)
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with known maximum severity
outcome: fatal, ka (NHTSA-imputed severity, primary); fatal_cc (complete-case sensitivity; see column 'outcome')
method: Survey-weighted (pseudo-ML) logistic models, ridge 0.01; predictive margins; Taylor linearisation with coefficient influence, summed within 67 PSUs / 25 strata; t with 42 df; delta method over coefficients, period means and margins
